Say someone puts a file from /usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/meta/ into the override dir root in /etc/configurations/. It'll still use it, right?

Looking at the code in ```configuration.cpp```, the 

```
11 constexpr const char* hostConfigurationDirectory = SYSCONF_DIR "configurations";
```

should be used aswell.

```
   35 // reads json files out of the filesystem
   36 bool loadConfigurations(std::list<nlohmann::json>& configurations)
   37 {
   38     // find configuration files
   39     std::vector<std::filesystem::path> jsonPaths;
   40     if (!findFiles(
   41             std::vector<std::filesystem::path>{configurationDirectory,
   42                                                hostConfigurationDirectory},
   43             R"(.*\.json)", jsonPaths))
   44     {
   45         std::cerr << "Unable to find any configuration files in "
   46                   << configurationDirectory << "\n";
   47         return false;
   48     }
```

Btw i noticed right above ```findFiles``` there is another ```findFiles``` which does not work on ```std::vector```.

We recurse into the correct one in our case but that would be a candidate for cleanup aswell, or convert to thin wrapper.

That other ```findFiles``` is only used in fru_device from what i can tell.
